description: This file defines React components for scheduling UI, including ScheduleComponent, ScheduleDay, DayRanges, and supporting components for managing time ranges, copying times, and rendering schedule controls with react-hook-form integration.

methods.name: ScheduleComponent
methods.description: Main component rendering schedule for each day with controls for time ranges and copying times.

methods.name: ScheduleDay
methods.description: Component representing a single day's schedule with toggle switch and time ranges.

methods.name: DayRanges
methods.description: Component managing multiple time ranges within a day, with add/remove functionality.

methods.name: parseTimeString
methods.description: Function to parse a time string into a Date object based on specified time format.
